notes: Read SKILL.md (356 lines) in full; it is the only file. The skill is a SOC alert-triage playbook (collect, correlate, classify, escalate) producing a disposition (TP/BTP/FP), priority (P1-P4) and escalation notice, mapped to ATT&CK tactic IDs and NIST SP 800-61r2 sections.

Read-only (allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob); it analyses alert data the user provides. SKILL.md:338-342 forbid executing commands from alert data, require redacting credentials/tokens, and leave containment to humans. The data-collection table (SKILL.md:73-81) names external tools (SIEM, EDR, VirusTotal/OTX/MISP) as places an analyst looks; the agent is not told to query them itself.

Optional pointers to sibling skills ir-playbook, detection-engineering, siem-rules and log-analysis (SKILL.md:45) are not shipped. SKILL.md:329 links ../../../schemas/finding.schema.json, used only when JSON output is requested.
